title: CadenceFinding
description: Schema for findings logged during Cadence review stages

rule_ref.description: Rule ID, ADR ID, or specification citation

location.description: File path and line range (path:Lstart-Lend) or hunk ID

evidence.description: Verbatim diff quote or command output demonstrating the issue

check.description: Deterministic command that passes when fixed (required for must-fix), or 'manual' with approver

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA where fix was introduced

verified_at.description: Timestamp when ledger_verify recorded passing check

verification_exit_code.description: Exit code recorded by ledger_verify execution

human_confirmed.description: Whether finding matches human review comment
